name: Asahina Mafuyu
source:
Mafuyu is an honor student who's both bright and humorous, and is relied upon by all. She's the only one in her music circle who regularly attends school, and shows great care and consideration for her fellow members while writing lyrics for their songs. At first glance, she appears to be the perfect honor student, but...

She's the lyricist of the underground music circle 25-ji, Nightcord de.

[From in-game profile]
